note: Own non-author render of cf8083b with ?screen=equipment. shell-2's fixes land: slot art is legible (sword, stick, slingshot, nuts, seeds, tunic), the selected slot is framed, tabs / rupees 16/200 / hearts / name + description / Rotate-Set-Back hints all sit where the reference has them. The criterion's 'character in an oval vignette' is still not met: the oval holds the selected item alone (a Deku Stick) where the reference shows Link's turntable holding it. Everything else on this screen passes.

history.note: First verdict on this item; rendered from 973a21e with ?screen=equipment in my own worktree, since no take captures the screen. Layout is close: the four tabs with Equipment active, the L and R glyphs, three hearts, the rupee count 16/200, the left hex grid, the centre oval, the right slot column and the Rotate/Set/Back hints are all where the reference has them, and the item name and its two description lines match the reference text. The screen fails on its centre: the oval holds a flat dark-green placeholder silhouette of Link, which the source itself labels a placeholder, where the reference has a full-colour 3-D render of the character holding the selected item, and that render is the focal element of the reference frame. Secondary: the left grid mixes hexagons with pentagon shapes where the reference's are all hexagons, and the slot art is flat vector where the reference's is rendered.
